content.short: GOSH is a decentralized Git and Ethereum Layer 2 that lets you run smart contracts for free.
content.description: GOSH delivers a framework for verifiable, decentralized code where integrity is preserved from source to delivery. In GOSH, each repository functions as a DAO with no traditional ownership and is governed in a decentralized manner, enabling broad consensus on code and content. It operates as an advanced, scalable, asynchronous, multi‑sharded Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain that lets developers run smart contracts on‑chain at no cost. GOSH is the first formally verified git, with git objects handled entirely on‑chain.
